messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Business Services and Partnerships" as it appears in the following examples.
['I AGREE THAT 30% OF THIS MONEY WILL BE FOR YOU AS FOREIGN PARTNER, IN RESPECT TO THE PROVISION OF A FOREIGN ACCOUNT AND 70% WOULD BE FOR ME;', 'Our sharing ratio will be subject to negotiation', 'I am compelled to contact you as result of a lifetime business relationship I wished to establish with your honorable self.', 'The money will be paid into your account for us to share in the ratio of 60% for mean 40% for you.', 'I will need your assistance in investing in your country.', 'This procedure is obligatory for all business and corporate clients of Entrust Bank.', 'I want you to do me a favor to receive this funds to safe account in your country or any safer place as the foreign partner/beneficiary I have plans to do investment in your country, like real estate houses and private school or importation of raw materials.', 'I decided to look for someone aboard who will help me receive and invest this money in a profitable business for the benefit of my adopted child', 'I need your urgent assistance in transferring the sum of $11.3 million immediately to your account.', 'REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR ELECTRONIC REVENUE COLLECTION SERVICES']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
